title: Consumer layers receive their collaborators

facts.note: Derived from the path's layer segment (presentation/ or application/); files with no layer segment do not activate.
Excludes test files and vendored/build directories.
OPTIONAL strengthening signal only, not a prerequisite: the rule applies to any consumer-layer module, including pre-existing construction and injection work that adds no `new` expression.
OPTIONAL signal: validator finding from bun_clean_architecture_detector on existing or new code.
Scopes only the 'During GREEN' prefer entries; the core obligation applies in any phase.

fires: A module under presentation/ constructs a repository or client with `new` instead of receiving it (new or pre-existing code).
An application-layer use case instantiates a service, adapter, gateway, store, provider or factory inside its body or constructor.
A task adds or changes a collaborator dependency of an application- or presentation-layer module.
doesNotFire: A `new` expression in a test file.
Code under vendored or build directories.
A file whose path carries no layer segment.
Wiring code in the composition root (governed by coder.bun.composition-root).
Construction inside domain or infrastructure layers.

given: A module in the presentation/ or application/ layer (a consumer layer: it uses collaborators rather than assembling them)
then: Receive the collaborator by injection (as a parameter or pre-wired) rather than constructing it inside the consumer.
prefer: Receive collaborators through parameters or already-wired construction.
Let the composition root decide which concrete collaborator is supplied.
During GREEN: reuse the consumer's existing injection shape when one exists.
During GREEN: add only the collaborator required by the current behavior.
During GREEN: prefer the narrowest existing contract over a new generalized interface.
avoid: Instantiating a repository, client, service, adapter, gateway, store, provider, or factory inside the consumer.
Redesigning unrelated constructor or function signatures.
unless: Test files and vendored/build directories are never scanned.
A file carrying no layer segment is outside these rules rather than in violation of them.
why: A consumer that builds its own collaborators cannot be tested without them — exactly how a unit test acquires a database. Composition-root says where wiring MAY happen; this rule says consumers must accept what they are given.
evidence: The consumer can be exercised with its collaborator supplied from outside.
bun_clean_architecture_detector reports no `new <Collaborator>()` inside a consumer-layer module.
verifier_detail: Detector: bun_clean_architecture_detector (validator). Flags a `new <Collaborator>()` inside a consumer layer (presentation or application).
Collaborator kinds: repository, client, service, adapter, gateway, store, provider, factory.
Test files and vendored/build directories are never scanned.
Bare npm specifiers resolve outside the project graph and are not layer-checked.
A file carrying no layer segment is outside these rules rather than in violation of them.
Severity 3; disposition strict (source label only; no further enforcement semantics defined by the source).
